summary.content:
Today's selection covers 103 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 67 on Artificial Intelligence and 17 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI Trial Starts With Two Very Different Tales of a Company’s Early Years
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BBC Technology, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 60 articles published in the last 24 hours
